distribution: Menglian, Yunnan, 1020 m above sea level.
soldier: Head oval, broad in the middle; labrum tongue-shaped, its tip bluntly rounded; each mandible with a minute marginal tooth near the middle and a denticle on the inner margin of the basal tooth; behind the denticle of the right mandible there is occasionally another minute pointed process; postmentum widest in the middle. Antennae with 16 segments, the fourth shortest. The anterior margin of the pronotum concave in the middle, the posterior margin nearly straight. In the small soldier the head and the body colour are paler than in the large soldier, and the morphology of all parts is similar to that of the large soldier.
